public_command_behavior_boundary: public commands and workflows are executable proof routing only and do not widen public runtime ABI or turn report-only/generated-report-only evidence into support

proof_boundary_policy.primary_axis: behavior owner before public command wrapper, workflow label, executable proof report, private runtime ABI snapshot, generated report, packaged proof summary, or public runtime ABI boundary
proof_boundary_policy.support_authority: executable proof reports and public workflows are provenance unless runtime or e2e owners claim behavior already supported by parser, sema, lowering, and IR owners
proof_boundary_policy.retired_surface_rule: report-only, generated-report-only, wrapper-only, workflow-label-only, private-snapshot-only, package-only, shim workflow, fallback workflow, old-mode command, milestone-specific scaffolding, and public ABI widening proof rows are provenance, canonical rejection, strict-error, or absent-support evidence
